saans.$description: Every text element on the site. Fractional weights (440, 456, 652) are the signature — they occupy visual mass between Regular and Semibold that no variable-axis font exposes as named stops. Display headlines at 80px/56px run weight 600–652 at lineHeight 1.00–1.13 with negative letter-spacing (-0.011em at large sizes). Body runs 14–16px at weight 400 with tracking +0.013–0.017em for small-size legibility.
